messages:
Dana (partnerships): Quick sync: EU marketplace asked for a compact SOC2 snapshot, a pen-test exec summary, and an evidence bundle with checksums. They want gated reviewer access instead of public full reports. Deadline EOW. Who owns what?
Ravi (security): I can own the SOC snapshot and redaction_map. Public artifact = one-page snapshot + exec summary; gated bucket = full reports. Will tag any items NEEDS_LEGAL.
Noel (cloud): Upload plan: partners/acme/2755550000/ with manifest.csv and metadata.json (include sha256). Multipart presign for >50MB. Example: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/partners/acme/2755550000/soc-snapshot.pdf --expires-in 604800
Sana (SI): Pen witness: 60min remote session preferred. I'll prepare a short runbook (auth, KV isolation, telemetry). Tentative slots Tue/Wed next week.
Priya (legal): I'll review redaction_map within 4 hours of receipt. If gated reviewer access is used we need a short reviewer agreement and access_policy_url to include in metadata.
Ellen (sales): Partner PR depends on publish; they agree to gated review for now. I'll push partner to deliver CI logs by tomorrow 11:00 PT.
marketplace-bot: Ingestion reminder: metadata fields required: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types, evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. Include access_policy_url for gated flows. See https://marketplace.docs/ingest
Dana (partnerships): Owners recap: Ravi -> SOC snapshot + redaction_map (due tomorrow 5pm PT), Noel -> upload + metadata + manifest (after legal OK), Sana -> witness runbook & schedule, Priya -> legal review, Ellen -> partner ops. Post manifest.json here (no secrets) when ready.
